asset.name: VirtualList
asset.description: The large-collection renderer with dynamic measurement, overscan, preserved focus, sticky items, scroll restoration, and accessible item-count semantics.

requires.reason: User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: The accessibility trap is item counts: a windowed list that reports only the rendered rows tells a screen-reader user the collection is twenty items long when it is twenty thousand.
